summary: Form 8-K filed by Fervo Energy Company on May 15, 2026, reporting amendments to its certificate of incorporation and bylaws in connection with its initial public offering (IPO). On May 14, 2026, the company completed an IPO of 80.5 million shares of Class A common stock at $27.00 per share, including full exercise of the underwriters' option, generating approximately $2.174 billion in gross proceeds. The filing includes the amended charter and bylaws. This is a routine IPO-related filing and does not constitute a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring.
